title: Take a picture
summary: Press '0'(Numpad zero) to pass in camera view
Press 'G' to move Press 'G+Z' to move on the Z-Axis (vertical) Press 'G+X' to move on the X-Axis (horizontal)
Press 'R+R' to rotate freely Press 'R+Z' to rotate along the Z-Axis Press 'R+X' to rotate along the X-Axis
Press 'F12' to Render an image Press 'F3' to save this image in a folder of your choice
